items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: He and Chick Webb, Sidney Catlett, Walter Johnson, Sammy Williams - we had two bands at the Savoy Ballroom... I used to tell Walter Johnson and Sidney Catlett and all of them...

ctx.x: (THIS IS NOT CLEAR AS PEOPLE ARE COMING IN OR LEAVING.)
Anyway, I think I was at the restaurant counter. Jay had gone on an errand. So Sidney Catlett and I were sitting at the table and I ordered a sandwich and Jay came back.

We were getting ready to make the train back to New York. So Bill Robinson comes up to the place. There's this white fellow. He was high. Well, he, you know, knocked up against me. I didn't pay him no mind. So Bill Robinson said - you know we were youngsters then, very young. So he said, "Is this man molesting you?" Nobody had recognized Bill Robinson, so he's going to take it out on me to be recognized, and that's what I didn't like and neither did Sid Catlett. I said, "No, he's not molesting me. The man is just…

items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: So Sid Catlett and I were sitting in the restaurant. We were waiting for our train to come in.

ctx.x: Nobody knows what happened. Nobody knew whatever happened because when we got to the cafeteria... Jay had to go
out on a little errand. So Sid Catlett and I were sitting in the restaurant. We were waiting for our train to come in. I'll tell you who else was up there was Rogers, the comedian.
